latest_release.name: Agent Autoloop 1.8.3
latest_release.body:
## 更新内容

- 卡片写明来源：飞书卡片、桌面通知、所有 Webhook 平台、卡片网页和 `status` 的待决定列表，都在标题下写出是哪条规则问的；标题本身就是规则名时不重复。
- Token 统计口径统一：各家 Agent 的输入都算上缓存，`status` 写出其中缓存占多少（如“1.3 亿 Token（其中缓存 96%）”），`/v1/state` 的 `spending` 多一个 `cached`。升级前记下的 Claude、DSH 轮次仍是旧口径，一周后自然对齐。
- 规则的 `elsewhere` 登记项可以写可选的 `model` 和 `effort`，随 `/v1/state` 带出，显示别处定时任务的客户端不必再借用 Agent 的设置。退回旧版本前先把这两个字段从规则里去掉。
- 飞书：兼容旧版 lark-cli（如 1.0.66），首次发送卡片不再一直失败。
- GitLab：评论事件沿用所属 Issue / MR 的事项编号，不同对象的评论不再混进同一事项。
- 接单程序：找不到某个 Agent 程序时不再记住这个结果，程序装回来后不用重启就能用。

感谢 16bh、loodeer、落尘（luochen211）、argszero 的贡献。

## What's changed

- Cards now say where they come from: Feishu cards, desktop notifications, every Webhook platform, the card page and the pending list in `status` show the rule under the title (not repeated when the title is the rule name).
- Token usage is counted the same way for every agent: input includes cache, and `status` shows the cached share (e.g. "130M tokens (96% cached)"); `spending` in `/v1/state` gains `cached`. Claude and DSH runs recorded before the upgrade keep the old basis and even out within a week.
- `elsewhere` entries in rules can carry optional `model` and `effort`, returned by `/v1/state`, so clients showing scheduled tasks run elsewhere no longer borrow the agent's settings. Remove these fields before rolling back to an older version.
- Feishu: works with older lark-cli releases (e.g. 1.0.66); the first card send no longer keeps failing.
- GitLab: comment events reuse the number of the Issue / MR they belong to, so comments on different objects no longer share one subject.
- Worker: a missing agent program is no longer remembered as missing; once it is installed again it is found without a restart.

Thanks to 16bh, loodeer, luochen211 and argszero.
